scenarios.title: Artifact role separates historical receipts from active plans

gherkin.given: identical node --test tests/portfolio-*.mjs text in a report receipt and an active scope Test Plan or structured test plan
gherkin.when: the production collector classifies both candidates
gherkin.then: the report site is historical while the active site remains authoritative with artifact and line provenance

obligations.requiredProof: Production collector output separates identical command bytes into historical and active authority states.
satisfiedBy: TP-BUG022-F01 :: Regression: SCN-BUG022-001 historical report receipts do not declare Node test globs
TP-BUG022-F02 :: Regression: SCN-BUG022-001 active scope Test Plan and structured test-plan commands remain authoritative

obligations.requiredProof: The active declaration retains its repository-relative artifact and positive source line.
satisfiedBy: TP-BUG022-F02 :: Regression: SCN-BUG022-001 active scope Test Plan and structured test-plan commands remain authoritative

testMechanism.negativeControl: Moving the identical command from report.md into an active scope Test Plan changes authority from historical to active.

gherkin.given: active-looking headings inside historical evidence, fenced headings, and a glob candidate on an unrecognized artifact surface
gherkin.when: the production collector classifies the candidates
gherkin.then: artifact role outranks headings, fenced headings do not alter section role, and the unknown candidate fails closed with provenance

obligations.requiredProof: Production heading and fence classification preserves the enclosing artifact role.
satisfiedBy: TP-BUG022-F03 :: Regression: SCN-BUG022-002 fenced and misheaded evidence cannot gain or escape artifact authority

obligations.requiredProof: An unknown candidate produces a named blocking classification error instead of disappearing or becoming historical.
satisfiedBy: TP-BUG022-F04 :: Regression: SCN-BUG022-002 unknown artifact roles fail closed with candidate provenance

obligations.requiredProof: Every classification error retains artifact, line, section context, and machine-readable reason.
satisfiedBy: TP-BUG022-F04 :: Regression: SCN-BUG022-002 unknown artifact roles fail closed with candidate provenance

testMechanism.negativeControl: Placing a matching command in an unrecognized Markdown artifact must change the result to a blocking classification error.

scenarios.title: Additive migration closes reachability without weakening runner ownership

gherkin.given: the original eight report-derived portfolio crossings and legitimate functional and test Node families
gherkin.when: the classifier and current command registry migration land together
gherkin.then: the eight false crossings disappear without ratchet growth, both Node families remain reachable, Playwright stays disjoint, and the historical report remains byte-identical

obligations.requiredProof: Repository validation derives zero new orphans, zero new crossings, unchanged ratchets, two active Node family declarations, and a byte-identical historical report.
satisfiedBy: TP-BUG022-F05 :: Regression: SCN-BUG022-003 historical receipt classification removes exactly eight portfolio crossings without baseline growth
TP-BUG022-F06 :: Regression: SCN-BUG022-003 active functional and test Node families remain reachable without report authority

obligations.requiredProof: Current Feature 008 production routes remain executable by Playwright after Node authority is narrowed.

testMechanism.negativeControl: An active portfolio-wide Node declaration recreates the eight crossings and fails the focused disjointness assertion.
